summary: Dedicated: streaming resets when fallback routing triggers mid-request
description: Customer on Dedicated reports that during capacity pressure, some streaming requests terminate early. They noticed it coincides with fallback routing events in their logs (model pin not strict).
comments: Support (Connor): Customer provided example where stream stops at token ~120 and client gets EOF.
Eng (Jordan): Gateway log shows fallback decision emitted after first tokens streamed; we should not fallback after response start.
Eng: Action: enforce 'no mid-stream fallback' invariant; either complete on original backend or fail fast before first chunk.
Support: Shared workaround: set strict model pinning and disable fallback policy for this route.
